R141.note: Clean html.escape() on ticket_id, priority, and status before concatenation; no other observable change.

R142.note: Drops mark_safe() entirely instead of keeping it on the composed string, so Django's default autoescaping will re-escape the trusted div markup itself, silently breaking the intended HTML banner rendering (shows literal escaped tags) rather than preserving it -- not disclosed.

R143.note: Moves ownership of req/req->payload cleanup fully to the caller; error-path logging still runs on valid memory before the single free; matches original success-path cleanup.

R144.note: Correctly moves name into a Jinja2 context var instead of the template source; render_template_string autoescapes by default (filename is None), so legitimate output is unchanged.

R145.note: Recomputes last_write_ptr from list->data + list->length after realloc; offsets and record placement unchanged otherwise.

R146.note: Minimal html.escape() on query.term only; nothing else altered.

R147.note: True allowlist of AST node types (Name/Constant/BinOp/UnaryOp + arithmetic ops), rejects undefined variable names and any non-arithmetic syntax, matching the stated contract exactly.

R148.note: The 'Recommended' Option 1 imports `render_string_template`, which does not exist in Flask (the real function is render_template_string) -- this option ImportErrors if used as written; Option 2 (markupsafe.escape) is a correct fallback but the write-up doesn't flag the primary option as broken.

R149.note: Refcounting correctly defers the free until the last holder (the queued callback) releases it; the log line executes on still-live memory; no observable output change versus intended behavior.

R150.note: The revalidation check itself reads ctx->conn->generation through the already-freed conn pointer -- still a use-after-free read (just relocated to the guard condition), not clearly exploitable only because nothing reallocates the freed block before the check runs in this toy program.

R151.note: Same correct single-option fix as R141: html.escape() on ticket_id/priority/status, nothing else changed.

R152.note: Leads with ast.literal_eval(), which cannot evaluate any expression referencing a variable name and would reject every legitimate formula under the stated contract; the AST-walk fallback is a denylist (blocks only Call/Import/Attribute) rather than an allowlist, leaving other node types such as Pow unvetted (DoS potential).

R153.note: Replaces Markup(label) with html.escape(label) inside a raw f-string response with no second templating layer, so there's no double-escaping risk; clean.

R154.note: Wraps draft.source as a literal value inside a static '{{ content }}' template, so a submitted draft's own {{ user.name }}/{{ campaign.name }} placeholders are never rendered -- this defeats the preview feature the contract requires (rendering with user/campaign data) while the write-up incorrectly claims it 'preserves the preview functionality.'

R155.note: markupsafe.escape() on query.term only, equivalent minimal correct fix to R146.

R156.note: Saves the offset before realloc and recomputes the pointer from list->data + write_offset afterward; logically equivalent correct fix to R145.
